title: Fallback HTTP listener activates unconditionally when tailnet binding fails
description: main.rs defaults fallback_bind_addr to '127.0.0.1:8080' when KITHD_BIND_ADDR is unset. When tailscaled is unavailable or returns no tailnet IPs, kithd silently falls back to plain HTTP on loopback — no TLS, no Tailscale WhoIs, full JMAP+blob+events API reachable by any local process. Fix: when KITHD_BIND_ADDR is not explicitly set and tailnet binding fails, refuse to start with a clear error.
